description: Source code for an Android foreground service (RecorderService) and its binder (RecorderServiceBinder) managing audio recording functionality, including lifecycle management, recording control, and coroutine-based timing.

classes.name: RecorderService
classes.description: An Android LifecycleService that manages recording lifecycle, binds to RecorderServiceBinder, and handles service creation, binding, and destruction.

classes.name: RecorderServiceBinder
classes.description: Binder class that manages MediaRecorder instance, recording state, timing, and controls starting/stopping recordings.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the binder when the service is created.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder instance when the service is bound.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops recording when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: killRecorder
methods.description: Stops and releases the MediaRecorder, optionally stops the service.

methods.name: initializeRecorder
methods.description: Sets up MediaRecorder with output file and URI, prepares it for recording.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Starts recording and launches a coroutine to track recording time.

methods.name: stopRecordingAndUnbind
methods.description: Unbinds the service connection and stops recording.
